# getArole — Your AI Job Search Partner

> getArole (https://getarole.in) is your AI job search partner. Stop searching job boards. getArole automatically matches your resume with verified jobs from top enterprises (Google, Microsoft, TCS, Infosys, Amazon) and 200+ high-growth tech startups.

## Overview
- **Name**: getArole
- **URL**: https://getarole.in
- **Target Audience**: Software Engineers, Frontend/Backend Developers, AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, Freshers (2025/2026 batches), Tech Job Seekers in India & Global Remote.
- **Key Categories**: Your AI Job Search Partner, AI Resume Matcher, Tech Recruitment Platform India, Off-Campus Drive Tracker, Career Intelligence.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **Autonomous Scraper Engine**: Runs every 3 hours across Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and enterprise portals. Active verified listings with zero expired or ghost jobs.
- **AI Matching**: Calibrates candidate resumes against complete job descriptions, generating semantic match scores and fit breakdowns.
- **Direct Apply Links**: Direct links to official company ATS application pages with no recruiter middlemen or paywalls.
- **Kanban Application Pipeline**: Live tracker for Saved, Applied, Interviewing, and Offer stages.
- **AI Resume Builder & ATS Tailor**: Generates ATS-optimized resumes tailored to specific target job descriptions.

## Top Hiring Companies on getArole
- **Indian IT Enterprises**: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Infosys, Wipro, HCL Technologies, Tech Mahindra, LTIMindtree, Cognizant.
- **Global Tech Giants**: Google India, Microsoft India, Amazon SDE, Meta, Apple, Adobe, Salesforce.
- **Top Indian Unicorns & Startups**: Razorpay, Zerodha, CRED, Swiggy, Flipkart, PhonePe, Meesho, Zepto, InMobi.
